construction.implementation_origin: New reference implementation written in this isolated build directory

optional.fixture_label: Nonempty descriptive string; example is explicitly synthetic
optional.half_life_days: Finite number greater than 0 and at most 3650, default 30

input.items: Array of objects: unique nonempty id, nonempty title and category, numeric popularity in [0,1]
input.events: Array of objects: nonempty user_id, catalog item_id, type browse|purchase, timezone-aware ISO 8601 timestamp no later than now
input.time: now must be an explicit timezone-aware ISO 8601 timestamp; timestamps normalize to UTC
input.validation: One validate function used by library and CLI; unknown fields, invalid types, duplicate item IDs and dangling event references rejected. CLI also rejects duplicate JSON fields and nonstandard numeric constants. All users' events are validated before filtering.

shared_schema.success_output: Object: status=ok, user_id, strategy=behavioral|cold_start, matched_event_count, excluded_purchase_count, recommendations
shared_schema.error_output: Object: status=error, message; CLI exits 2 on validation, JSON or file errors; exits 0 on success

cross_stage_handoffs: Single behavior only: validated normalized request -> recency-weighted user affinities -> ranked shared JSON response

behavior.affinity: Sum weighted events per category and item, divided by total user event weight. Repeat events count as repeat behavior.
behavior.cold_start: No matching positive representable event weight: rank solely by supplied popularity. Empty catalogs return empty recommendations.
behavior.purchases: Purchased items excluded by default, regardless of age; their events still influence category affinity. Opt out with exclude_purchased=false.
behavior.determinism: No random values, wall-clock reads, or providers. Sort weight lists before summing; descending unrounded score, then ascending case-sensitive item ID; display scores and affinities rounded to 8 decimals.
behavior.limiting: Apply limit after eligibility filtering and ranking; zero limit is valid.

test_outcomes.suite: 12 unittest methods covering normal, edge, invalid input, determinism, decay, cold start and CLI behavior
test_outcomes.cli: Passed: exit 0, one JSON object, status ok, behavioral strategy, book-b ranked first; invalid/file CLI cases exit 2 with JSON error
